note: The fvar table axis count from the font becomes the number of variation axes used to size and scan default instance coordinate arrays.
The default coordinate buffer is allocated as two bytes per axis even though fvar axis default coordinates are Fixed values requiring four bytes per axis.
The parser walks the input-controlled fvar axis records and fills the undersized default coordinate buffer while advancing the destination by the assumed per-axis element size.
Instance coordinate bytes from the fvar table are copied into the instance coordinate buffer sized with the same too-small per-axis assumption, reaching the target heap write path.
